en: The table is messy, and everyone is busy... who can help? You can!
Lady Aisha, Radi Allahu Anha, was asked: What did <SAW> do in his home?
She said: he helped his family at home!
And when it was time to pray, he went to pray.
So let's help at home too! Tidy your toys, set the table, and fold your clothes.
Helping your family is a beautiful sunnah, and it makes everyone smile.
What will you help with today? Tell your grown-up!
